purpose: Freeze the identity and trace contracts that must remain compatible while additive correlation is introduced.

futureAdditiveFields.rule: Readers must be upgraded before producers emit these fields. Their future presence must not change any legacy field or key.

producerEnable: all readers accept optional additive fields
legacy golden replay is byte-for-byte equal for selected identity fields
old trace query and deep-link tests pass
readerOptIn: split, merge and collision rates meet the release threshold
the reader has an independent rollback switch
rollback: disable additive producer and reader switches
keep legacy columns, query parameters, IDs and state keys unchanged

consumers.compatibilityPromise: Do not silently reinterpret existing process identity fields or raw event names.
consumers.switchingGate: Any future capture switch is off by default and must preserve critical lifecycle discovery when disabled.

consumers.compatibilityPromise: Existing source-event identity and attribution fields remain present and keep their current meaning.
consumers.switchingGate: Additive correlation emission stays disabled until API and stream readers are compatible.

consumers.compatibilityPromise: Legacy query parameters and canonical identity values remain unchanged; additive identity never overwrites traceId.
consumers.switchingGate: Reader/schema support lands before any producer; new invocation queries are independent of traceId queries.

writes: event and finding columns keyed by existing revision semantics
consumers.compatibilityPromise: Legacy columns remain queryable and historical traceId is never rewritten.
consumers.switchingGate: Add nullable/defaulted columns first; replay must not create a legacy revision conflict.

consumers.compatibilityPromise: The v1 topic and current partition key remain unchanged during additive shadowing.
consumers.switchingGate: Do not re-key the v1 topic; a future key requires a parallel versioned topic.

consumers.compatibilityPromise: Existing agentCorrelationId/session state keys and savepoints remain valid.
consumers.switchingGate: Upgrade the strict POJO reader first; any new episode key uses a parallel pipeline and tested savepoint migration.

writes: eventId, agentInstanceId, sessionId, traceId and runId URL query parameters
consumers.compatibilityPromise: Old bookmarks and traceId deep links continue to resolve to the same legacy chain.
consumers.switchingGate: Invocation navigation is added as a separate opt-in query parameter and never changes traceId semantics.

consumers.compatibilityPromise: The existing event/workspace/agent/trace/risk dedupe identity remains stable.
consumers.switchingGate: Any invocation-aware dedupe is shadow-only until duplicate and split rates are accepted.

consumers.compatibilityPromise: The current Incident hash inputs and resulting incidentId remain unchanged.
consumers.switchingGate: A future invocation incident view must be a separate versioned identity, not an in-place hash change.

writes: evidence scope and deep-link query parameters
consumers.compatibilityPromise: Legacy evidence selectors continue returning the same trace-scoped evidence.
consumers.switchingGate: Add invocation selection independently and retain the legacy selector path for old bundles.
New correlation references are additive; legacy references remain authoritative until explicit opt-in.
